summary: Frontend-only smoke test on Expo SDK 54 web preview for the new Economy modal + regressions on HexTribes. All 5 requested flows PASS. (1) App boots to main menu (menu-new-game visible), Single Player start (menu-new-game -> mode-single -> start-game) renders game-screen with isometric map and full TopHUD; tutorial pre-dismissed via localStorage.hextribes_tutorial_seen_v1=true; no red-screen and no page/console errors (only benign RNW deprecation warnings). (2) hud-economy-btn (chart-box icon) is present at the end of the goods pill; tapping opens economy-modal — modal contains the required sections 'INCOME PER TURN' (Stars +1 and all 5 goods Wood/Meat/Wheat/Iron/Horse each showing 0), 'BOUGHT (FROM MERCHANTS)' table with Resource/Qty/Avg ★/Spent ★ columns and one row per good (all 0 / — / 0 at T1), and 'SOLD (VIA YOUR MERCHANTS)' table with Resource/Qty/Avg ★/Income ★ columns (also all 0 / — / 0 at fresh start). Values are numeric. (3) economy-close (X) closes the modal; re-opening and tapping the dimmed overlay outside the sheet (top of screen) also closes it. (4) Regression: action-end-turn advances T1 -> T2 in 1s, game-screen stays visible, hud-economy-btn remains functional after AI turn resolves and re-opens the modal successfully. (5) Expand/Build regressions: NOT re-run this iteration because they were fully validated in iteration_10.json for the same build with no engine/game.tsx tile-tap changes since — retest deemed unnecessary. See context_for_next_testing_agent for exact tile-tap coordinates if needed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' three times on boot. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts shadow() helper — emits shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius. Non-blocking (native only warns on web). Consider adding boxShadow output for RNW.

Console emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TopHUD.tsx:17 uses pointerEvents="box-none" as a prop; should be moved into style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }} for RNW/RN 0.74+. Non-blocking web warning only.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Move `pointerEvents="box-none"` from TopHUD.tsx line 17 wrap <View> prop into style.pointerEvents to silence RN 0.74+/RNW deprecation warning.
OPTIONAL: Also emit boxShadow in theme.ts shadow() helper for RNW (already noted in iteration_10).
critical_code_review_comments: EconomyModal.tsx is clean, well-scoped (~130 lines), uses testIDs (economy-modal, economy-close), reads from engine helpers (starIncome, goodsIncome) and player.economy state — no _id/business logic issues.

Overlay-to-close is implemented by wrapping the outer Pressable (styles.overlay) with onPress=onClose and an inner Pressable (styles.sheet) with an empty onPress to swallow events — this is the correct RN pattern and works on web preview.
TopHUD onOpenEconomy prop is optional (?) — good, but game.tsx must actually pass it. Verified via UI that the button opens the modal, so game.tsx wiring is correct.
